fullContentHtml:
UPPSC GIC Lecturer Answer Key 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC) has released the answer key for the recruitment of Lecturer (GIC) posts on its official website. This recruitment was released for 1516 posts. Applications for the UPPSC GIC Lecturer Recruitment 2025 were accepted from August 12, 2025, to September 12, 2026. The online examination was held on 14 & 17 June 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their UPPSC GIC Lecturer Answer Key 2026 from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 12 August 2025
  • Last Date : 12 September 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 12 September 2025
  • Correction Last Date : 17-27 March 2026
  • Exam Date : 14 & 17 June 2026
  • Admit Card : 04 June 2026
  • Answer Key Available : 18 June 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 125/-
  • SC, ST Candidates : Rs. 65/-
  • Ex-Service Candidates : Rs. 65/-
  • PH Candidates: Rs.25/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
